audience.reading_trigger: They are being asked to ship agents without eval infrastructure.

why_it_matters: RAG without evals is a demo, not a product — the fix is a golden set before scale.

key_aspects.tension: Teams skip them and discover regressions in production.
Judges drift with model updates; human sampling stays necessary.
Eval latency fights deploy speed; budgets must be explicit.

post_angles.angle: Ship the golden set before the agent.
post_angles.why_now: Agent incidents spike while eval budgets stay at zero.

post_angles.angle: Your judge model is a moving target.
Eval latency is a deploy tax worth paying.

evidence_gaps: No public benchmark for internal RAG eval cost.
